# Claude Quickstarts

> Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-quickstarts
> Docs: https://console.anthropic.com/
> Cached: 2026-03-12

## What is Claude Quickstarts?

A collection of projects designed to help developers quickly get started with building deployable applications using the Claude API. Each quickstart provides a foundation that you can easily build upon and customize.

## Prerequisites

- Claude API key from console.anthropic.com

## Available Quickstarts

### Customer Support Agent
AI-assisted customer support system with knowledge base access. Demonstrates natural language understanding and generation capabilities.

### Financial Data Analyst
Financial data analysis via chat with interactive data visualization powered by Claude.

### Computer Use Demo
Environment and tools for Claude to control a desktop computer. Supports the latest `computer_use_20251124` tool version with zoom actions.

### Browser Tools API Demo
Complete reference implementation for browser automation powered by Claude. Demonstrates web interaction, navigation, DOM inspection, and form manipulation using Playwright.

### Autonomous Coding Agent
Two-agent pattern (initializer + coding agent) powered by Claude Agent SDK. Builds complete applications over multiple sessions with progress persisted via git and feature lists.

## General Usage

1. Clone this repository
2. Navigate to the specific quickstart directory
3. Install required dependencies
4. Set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable
5. Run the quickstart application
